title: Retire a replaced slide while retaining its replacement context
preconditions: Use shop Saga with implementation deck and SQS slide explaining pay/charged, committed on main.

steps.action: On a branch supersede the SQS relation, remove SQS slide, add a Postgres slide explaining the same criterion, and commit with subject and body explaining the replacement.
steps.expected_result: The new slide replaces SQS; SQS is classified retired and removed, and both changes retain the commit reason.

expected_result: The new slide replaces SQS; SQS is classified retired and removed, and both changes retain the commit reason.
